html:
Find answers to the most common questions about DeHub, our token ecosystem, and platform features.

What is DeHub?

DeHub is a decentralised user owned alternative to legacy media apps such as X, Facebook, YouTube and Rumble, that utilises the advancements in blockchain technology to offer users a whole new world of possibilities.

What are DeHub tokens used for?

DeHub tokens provide utility across the entire DeHub ecosystem including access to games and content, global transactions, tipping creators, purchasing on the NFT marketplace, governance voting, staking for rewards, and network security.

How does DeHub's governance system work?

Proposals are raised and voted on from the Governance page. Opening a proposal costs a fee of 10,000 DeHub tokens, confirmed on chain, which keeps the board free of spam. Voting itself is free and weighted by your staking badge. A vote runs for seven days, and a proposal passes on a weighted majority only if at least ten different wallets took part, so no single large holder can pass something on their own.

Where can I buy DeHub tokens?

DeHub tokens (DHB) are available on various exchanges. Check our 'Where to Buy' section for the most up-to-date list of supported exchanges and trading pairs.

How do I bridge DeHub tokens?

You can bridge DeHub tokens between BASE and BNB chains using our token bridge. Visit the Token Bridge section in our documentation for detailed instructions, bridge addresses, and processing times. Simply copy the appropriate bridge address and follow the step-by-step process.

Can I stake DeHub tokens?

Yes, you can stake DeHub tokens to earn real yield from protocol revenue buybacks and x-2-earn rewards. Staking also helps secure the network and provides enhanced rights within the ecosystem.

What games are available on DeHub?

Six games run inside DeHub itself, in a browser tab, with nothing to install and nothing to buy: King's Gambit (3D chess with an online Elo ladder), Claude of Duty (a shooter that generates all of its own art on your machine), Jungle Trail (a procedurally generated rainforest walk), Street Slayer (a side-scrolling beat 'em up built for DeHub), Chartopia (a walkable trading floor that also runs in a VR headset) and God's Eye (a live 3D globe of the DeHub community). Last Chad Standing, our flagship MMA battle royale, is in development.

How does the DePIN infrastructure work?

DeHub's DePIN (Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Network) allows users to contribute computing resources and earn rewards while helping to build a decentralized infrastructure network.

What are DeHub's AI Toolkits?

Our AI Toolkits provide developers and users with advanced AI-powered tools and services integrated into the DeHub ecosystem, enhancing functionality across d'Apps and games.

How does advertising work on DeHub?

DeHub offers a decentralized advertising platform where advertisers can create campaigns, target specific audiences, and pay with DeHub tokens. Content creators can earn rewards for displaying relevant ads.

Is DeHub secure?

Yes, DeHub has undergone security audits by Certik and maintains a bug bounty program. We prioritize security across all our smart contracts and infrastructure.

What is the total supply of DeHub tokens?

The total supply of DeHub tokens is 8,000,000,000 (8 billion), fully diluted from TGE with no ongoing emissions. See our Token Economics section for the full distribution breakdown.

How can I participate in DeHub governance?

Token holders take part from the Governance page: read and discuss proposals in their threaded comments, vote for or against for free with a weight set by your badge, or open a proposal of your own for a 10,000-token fee. The DAO treasury page lets anyone contribute DeHub tokens and vote on how that treasury is spent, in proportion to what they have contributed.

What are the benefits of holding DeHub tokens?

Benefits include access to enhanced features, global transactions, creator tipping, NFT marketplace purchases, governance rights, staking rewards, network security participation, and future utility expansions.

Can I tip content creators on DeHub?

Yes, you can tip creators and reward viewers by attaching bounties to published or token-locked content using DeHub tokens.

What is the Phygital NFT Marketplace?

Our marketplace allows users to purchase digital collectibles, physical assets, and services using DeHub tokens, bridging the gap between physical and digital ownership.

How do I access DeHub's d'Apps?

You can access DeHub's d'Apps through our main platform. DeHub token holders get enhanced features and functionality across all current and future d'Apps.

What is DeHub's roadmap?

Our roadmap includes expanding the d'App ecosystem, launching new games, enhancing DePIN infrastructure, developing AI toolkits, and continuing the platform-wide governance rollout.

How can I contact the DeHub team?

You can reach us through our official channels: tech@dehub.net for technical issues, or follow us on Twitter and Instagram @dehub_official for updates and community engagement.

Are DeHub tokens an investment?

No, DeHub tokens are strictly for utility purposes within the DeHub ecosystem, similar to in-game or in-app digital currencies. They are not investment instruments and markets are highly volatile.

How does content moderation work on DeHub?

DeHub uses a decentralized content moderation system where community members can participate in dispute management and content moderation to earn rewards while maintaining platform quality.

How do I sign up? Do I need a crypto wallet?

No. You can sign in with Google, Apple or Telegram, with a code sent to your email address or by SMS, or with a passkey, and a non-custodial wallet is created for you in the background — you hold the keys and we never take custody. If you already have a wallet you can connect it or import its keys instead. Sign-ins that are not wallet-based also have their gas fees sponsored, so you can post, tip and collect without ever buying a native token.

Is posting free?

Yes, up to a daily allowance that scales with your staking badge. Every account gets ten text posts and one gigabyte of video, images and audio free each day, and both pools reset at midnight UTC. Past that, the rest of that day is priced in DeHub tokens — roughly 10c a text post and $2 a gigabyte, charged pro-rata and only on the part that runs over. Reposts, comments, reactions, tips and messages never count against it.

Do I have to mint my posts as NFTs?

No. Minting is optional. A post publishes off-chain the moment you send it, with no wallet signature and no gas, and you can mint it later from the post itself if you want the ERC-1155 and the royalty that comes with it.

What does a staking badge actually get me?

A badge lowers your platform fee by 0.69% per tier, raises your free daily posting allowance and discounts anything past it, gives you the same 5%–30% discount when buying DeHub tokens, unlocks superpowers and profile cosmetics, and makes your views and reactions count for more. The thirteen tiers are priced in dollars rather than a fixed number of tokens, and once you have earned a tier the price cannot take it back off you.

Can I lend my badge to someone else?

Yes. Each rung you have climbed gives you one delegation slot, and a slot lends another account your own tier for as long as you leave it there — so a crew or a second account carries the tier of whoever backs it. A delegated badge names its patron on hover, and can be taken back at any time. It carries the tier's weight but not the things priced in money: your fee tier, purchase discount, posting allowance and delegation slots all still come from the stake you hold yourself.

What are Stages?

Live audio rooms built into DeHub. A host opens a room and brings speakers on stage, listeners drop in from the Stages page or a shared link, and the production layer adds a DJ soundboard, voice effects, radio stations, screen share and browser go-live with no OBS needed. Rooms carry live subtitles translated into whatever language each listener is reading, can be dubbed aloud in the host's own cloned voice, and every stage records for seekable replay afterwards.

Can I use DeHub on my phone?

Yes. The Android app is on Google Play, and the latest build is also a direct APK download from dehub.io/apk. The web app at dehub.io installs to your home screen on any device. Your account, badge and balance are the same on all of them.

How do I control what I see?

Creators mark a post mature while composing it, and those posts stay off the public home feed and out of search unless you turn on "Show mature content" in settings. You can mute or block an author from the ⋯ menu on any post, choose per category which notifications reach you, and turn on Kids Mode, protected by a PIN, so a device shows only posts made for children.

What language is DeHub in?

Over a hundred. Posts and comments translate into your language as you scroll with nothing to set up and no wallet connection required, the interface itself is translated, and live stages are captioned and translated in real time.
